note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 19, 16; A06b Const 19, 16; L05 Const 24(1); Const 24(4)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Malaysia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Malaysia for 12 months immediately prior to the application, and was resident (holding Malaysian permanent resident status) in the country for 10 out of 12 years prior to the application. ... n.a. ... Person acquired citizenship of another country by a voluntary and formal act other than by marriage; Person is a woman who is a citizen by registration and who subsequently acquired citizenship of another country through marriage with a foreigner.
